title: Agents on AWS Lab
description: Lab 8 of an AI Engineering curriculum: Terraform for a private-node EKS cluster with KMS-encrypted secrets and audit logs, IRSA with a least-privilege role trusted by one service account, S3, ECR and Secrets Manager; a hardened Helm chart with probes, autoscaling, disruption budgets, network policy and render-time guards; infrastructure tests with a mocked AWS provider and negative controls; and a kind-cluster deployment in CI gated by the previous lab's eval and promotion gates.
notes: Code is licensed under MIT; the written material (articles/) is licensed under CC BY 4.0. Kestrel Labs is fictional. No AWS resources were created to produce this lab; see the README for what is and is not verified.
